# BotWave

> The all-in-one no-code WhatsApp + Telegram bot platform. 150+ commands, AI assistant (Gemini 2.0 Flash), sticker maker, group moderation, anti-ban, broadcasts. Built for Nigeria, Africa, and the global Diaspora — but works anywhere.

BotWave converts your existing WhatsApp number or Telegram account into a fully programmable bot in under two minutes. Sign up, pair via QR/pairing code, and 150+ commands are immediately available in your chats and groups.

Site: https://www.botwave.online
Dashboard: https://www.botwave.online/dashboard
Sign up free: https://www.botwave.online/signup

## What BotWave does

- WhatsApp bot (Baileys-based, your device IP, anti-ban hardened)
- Telegram bot (Bot API) and Telegram userbot
- AI assistant — !ai / !chat — powered by Google Gemini 2.0 Flash with Groq Llama 3.1 fallback
- Sticker creation — !sticker (static + animated WebP, max 512×512)
- Group management — welcome messages, anti-spam, anti-link, anti-flood, warning system, captcha
- Media downloads — YouTube, TikTok, Instagram Reels (no watermark)
- Games — !trivia, !hangman, !wordchain, !numguess
- Utilities — !translate, !weather, !define, !joke, !quote, !time
- Scheduling — !schedule, !remind, !post
- Broadcasts — !tagall (within groups), opt-in audience broadcasts
- Custom commands per workspace
- 150+ commands total — see /commands

## Who uses BotWave

- Nigerian SMBs running customer service on WhatsApp (auto-reply, FAQ AI, after-hours)
- Schools and universities running class/department groups (anti-spam, AI tutor, exam revision quizzes)
- Churches and mosques (weekly schedule reminders, anti-link, prayer requests)
- Online vendors and ecommerce (price/availability AI, restock broadcasts)
- Crypto/Web3 community moderators (anti-link, anti-impersonator, !price feeds)
- Content creators and influencers (paid fan groups, engagement games)
- Healthcare and fitness providers (appointment reminders, check-ins)
- Delivery / logistics startups (rider coordination, customer ETA FAQs)
- Real estate agents (listing AI, viewing-slot booking)
- Political campaigns (volunteer mobilisation, multilingual outreach)

## Anti-ban approach (why we exist)

WhatsApp bans bulk unsolicited messaging. BotWave's stack is engineered NOT to look like spam:

1. Session warmup: starts at 15 msgs/day for new sessions, ramps to 200/day over 7 days
2. Randomised typing delays (1.2–3.8s based on message length)
3. Message variation (never sends identical message twice)
4. Hard daily cap (200/day default, configurable)
5. Realistic active hours (suppresses sends 02:00–06:00 local time)
6. Read receipt management (mirrors human behaviour)
7. Your own device IP via Baileys (no shared server IP fingerprint)

Result: <0.5% ban rate across 12,000+ active sessions through 2026.
